epic.name: Task board, task detail, and settings
unverifiedAssumptions: The 'active' column given the blue heading is In progress (To do stays neutral, Done is green). The design only colours Done; the requirement says the active column header uses primary blue without naming which — confirm In progress is intended.

Until Settings ships, the header shows the signed-in person's name from the fixed seeded team (by email); renaming yourself won't update the header until Settings adds the saved-name store (resolved by Story 3).

A brand-new task defaults its Assignee to the signed-in team member (so the new card shows an owner/initials). The design doesn't specify a default — confirm you'd like it pre-filled to you rather than starting Unassigned.
The mock task store is in-memory: create/edit/move/delete persist while you navigate within a session, but a full browser refresh resets to the seeded starting tasks (no real backend yet).
Settings 'Save' shows a success toast and stays on the Settings page (it does not navigate back to the board) — confirm this is the desired feel.
